description: Add a rule for one date: the dinner should be of this category (Hard = must, Soft = preferably). The answer's undo deletes the rule again.

category.description: The meal category for that day.

strength.description: Soft unless the household says the rule must hold. Hard ONLY when the words are must/never/always (må/aldri/alltid/skal/kan ikke/ikke lov). Everything else is Soft — a preference the planner may bend on a tight week — including a bare statement said in passing («Taco på fredager», «Fisk to ganger i uka», «Maks 30 minutter på hverdager») and helst/gjerne/prøv. «Maks», «minst» and a number name the limit, not its strength: they do not make a rule Hard.

name: set_category_for_date
title: Set a day's dinner category
